Method: Two alternating baseline/final process pairs, seven measured repetitions after one full-workload warmup per process. Same final benchmark assembly, preserved pre-change production binaries in control-final, current production binaries in retained-final. All 15 immutable owned seeds. GC allocation totals include asynchronous continuations. Cumulative parent-process peak excludes child processes. Timings are descriptive on a shared host and are not a universal speedup claim.

Baseline.Warmup: one complete workload per scenario before seven measured repetitions
Baseline.PeakMemory: cumulative benchmark-process peak working set, excludes supervised children
